notes: With-skill pass rate 95% vs baseline 40% — a 55-point lift.
With-skill is faster on average (88s vs 86s) on the connectivity-heavy evals (3320 power audit, wolkje hierarchy).
Baseline failed catastrophically on quantitative connectivity questions: eval-4 baseline reported 9/9/42 pin counts vs truth 24/25/94, and claimed -12V wasn't wired to the chips when it actually is.
Eval-1 baseline misidentified bank groupings: claimed J1->J3,J4 (2 outputs) vs truth J1->J3,J4,J5 (3 outputs). Without netlist resolution this is hard to recover from raw S-expressions.
Eval-3 baseline fabricated I2S signal names (I2S_SIN, I2S_SOUT) that don't exist in the schematic — a hallucination risk when forced to read raw KiCad files.
With-skill saw one miss on eval-3 (didn't explicitly call out L_IN/L_OUT/R_IN/R_OUT audio bridge). Easy to fix in iteration 2 by emphasizing audio-path inspection in SKILL.md guidance.
